idea-plugin.name: Robot Framework
idea-plugin.description:
Robot Framework — Full IDE Intelligence for Robot Framework

Turn your JetBrains IDE into a complete Robot Framework development environment: Robot Framework 7.4 syntax support, code completion, navigation, inspections with one-click migration fixes, a formatter, and test execution from the gutter.

Robot Framework 7.4 Syntax

  • GROUP blocks (RF 7.2) — highlighting, folding, completion, live template and END matching
  • Variable type conversion (RF 7.3) — ${amount: int}, @{ids: list[int]} and ${dir: Literal["UP", "DOWN"]} are highlighted, completed and validated
  • Secret variables (RF 7.4) — completion, live template and a check that rejects literal secrets
  • VAR statement (RF 7.0/7.1) — completion for every scope including SUITES
  • Inline IF, [Setup] on user keywords, -tag removal, WHILE limits (RF 7.0) — understood by the editor and the inspections
  • Migration help — one-click fixes for [Return], Force Tags, WITH NAME, singular section headers and the deprecated loop keywords

Editing and Navigation

  • Syntax Highlighting — Full support for Robot Framework 7.4 markers, typed variables, tags and sections
  • Code Completion — Context-aware suggestions for keywords, variables, and library imports
  • Go-To Declaration — Jump to keyword definitions and find references across files
  • Rename Refactoring — Safely rename keywords across all project files
  • Structure View — Browse test cases, keywords, and variables in a tree view
  • Code Folding — Collapse sections, test cases, and keywords

Code Quality

  • Code Formatter — One-shot reformat (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R) that normalizes section headers, expands tabs to spaces, trims trailing whitespace, and tidies blank lines
  • Inspections — Detect long test names, empty test cases, undefined keywords, missing resources, duplicate test-case names, tab separators, trailing whitespace, leftover TODO/FIXME markers, and unused suite variables
  • Quick Fixes — Convert tabs to spaces and strip trailing whitespace with a single keystroke
  • Error Annotations — Syntax errors, undefined variables, and duplicate keywords highlighted inline
  • Spellchecking — Spell check support for Robot Framework files
  • Parameter Hints — Inline parameter hints for keyword arguments

Test Execution

  • Run from the gutter — Every test case gets a Run icon; one click executes just that test
  • Run configurations — Suite or directory, --test, --include/--exclude tags, --outputdir, extra arguments, interpreter and working directory
  • Run with DEBUG log — One action to re-run with --loglevel DEBUG when a failure needs the detail
  • Safe invocation — Robot is started as <interpreter> -m robot with an argument list, never through a shell

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, or compatible JetBrains IDE (2024.2+)
  • Python with Robot Framework installed (needed for test execution)

Support

  • Documentation: jakubjirak.com
  • Issues: GitHub
  • Email: support@jakubjirak.com

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.6.2 — Freemium Descriptor Restored

  • Reverts 2026.6.1. The freemium product-descriptor is back. It was removed on the mistaken assumption that it gated features — it never did: with optional="true" the licence is not checked and every feature is available to everyone, which is exactly the intended model. A monetized listing also requires the descriptor to be present

2026.6.0 — Real Test Execution

  • Test execution actually runs your tests. The previous run configuration ignored every setting and executed robot --version. It now builds a real command line: suite or directory, --test, --include/--exclude, --outputdir, extra arguments, interpreter and working directory, started as <interpreter> -m robot with an argument list so nothing passes through a shell
  • Run gutter icons — every test case and task gets a Run icon
  • Run from context — Run Test (Ctrl+Shift+F10) runs the test under the caret, or the whole suite; right-click and the project view work too
  • Run with DEBUG log (Ctrl+Shift+F9) — re-runs with --loglevel DEBUG
  • Generate Keyword now works — it takes the keyword call under the caret, creates the *** Keywords *** section when missing, and places the caret on the generated step
  • Suite settings are highlighted — Library, Test Tags, Suite Setup and friends were rendered as plain text
  • Variable types are visible — the RF 7.3 type annotation fell back to a colour the IntelliJ Light scheme leaves unstyled, so it looked identical to the variable name
  • Removed placeholder features — the "Interactive REPL" opened a message box, the "Web Inspector" and "Test Results" tool windows were static labels. They are gone rather than pretending; test output now goes to the normal run console

2026.5.0 — Robot Framework 7.4 Syntax

  • GROUP blocks (RF 7.2) — highlighting, folding, completion, live template and END matching
  • Variable type conversion (RF 7.3) — ${amount: int}, @{ids: list[int]} and ${mode: Literal["UP", "DOWN"]} are highlighted, completed and validated
  • Secret variables (RF 7.4) — completion, live template and an inspection that rejects literal secrets
  • VAR scopes (RF 7.0/7.1) — completion for LOCAL/TEST/TASK/SUITE/SUITES/GLOBAL plus a warning when a non-local VAR is created without a value (deprecated in RF 7.4)
  • Deprecated syntax inspection — [Return], Force Tags, WITH NAME, singular section headers, Exit For Loop and friends, FOR IN ZIP without mode=, literal -tag in Test Tags — each with a one-click fix where the migration is mechanical
  • Block structure inspection — unclosed IF/FOR/WHILE/TRY/GROUP and orphan END, with inline IF handled correctly
  • Fixed section header parsing — *** Settings *** and friends are now recognized as whole headers, which repairs highlighting, folding, structure view, completion and navigation
  • Tasks and Comments sections — *** Tasks *** behaves like Test Cases, and *** Comments *** content is greyed out as data Robot Framework ignores
  • Empty test case detection rewritten — now text-based and reliable, with a real "Add No Operation" fix
  • .txt files are no longer claimed — Robot Framework dropped the plain-text format, so the plugin now registers only .robot and .resource

2026.4.0 — Code Quality & Formatting

  • Robot file formatter — Reformat a suite with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R: canonical section headers, tabs → spaces, trimmed trailing whitespace, and normalized blank lines (idempotent)
  • New inspections — Duplicate test-case name, tab separator, trailing whitespace, unresolved TODO/FIXME markers, and unused suite variables
  • Quick fixes — Convert tabs to spaces and remove trailing whitespace
  • Formatter settings — Configure indent size and header normalization under Settings → Tools → Robot Framework

2026.3.6 — Freemium Model

  • Freemium licensing — Added product-descriptor for JetBrains Marketplace freemium model (code: PROBOTFRAMEWORK)
